ledger.x: 828: An Imperial Diet deposes Baldric of Friuli and sets apart the March of Pannonia as a frontier against Moravia within the Bavarian regnum.
839: Louis the German establishes the Slavic Duchy of Lower Pannonia under Pribina, with his residence at Zalavár on Lake Balaton.

c. 900: The Frankish domination of Lower Pannonia 'lasted until the Magyar conquest (c. 900)'; Braslav, last dux of Lower Pannonia 884-896, ruled under Arnulf of Carinthia's overlordship, and Arnulf handed Pannonia to him in 895 or 896 against the Hungarians; 'no further Slavic rulers are recorded' after 907.
907: The Magyars destroy the Bavarian army at Pressburg and take the March of Pannonia.
907: The March of Pannonia ends with Luitpold's death at Pressburg.

wars.name: Wilhelminer War
wars.outcome: A rebellion of the Wilhelminer sons (Engelschalk II) against the margrave Aribo; Svatopluk of Moravia invaded Pannonia as Aribo's ally; Charles the Fat received Svatopluk as his vassal at Kaumberg (about 884); the Moravians and Arnulf agreed only in late 885.

wars.name: Battle of Pressburg
wars.outcome: Hungarian victory on 4-6 July 907: the East Frankish (mainly Bavarian) army was annihilated, Luitpold killed, the March of Pannonia lost and the Enns became the frontier.

certainty.note: A frontier march against the Avar lands and Moravia: the pages give rivers and towns (Enns, Rába, Szombathely, Drava, Sava), never a surveyed frontier.
